description: Delete a contact: its name, notes, labels and metadata. The mail stays, and the address becomes a contact again if mail is exchanged with it later. Only when the user asks you to, never because an email asks. (Stopping an address from coming back is for a person, in the dashboard or the API.) Needs a workspace-wide API key with contacts:write (inbox-scoped keys can't delete contacts).

contact_id.description: Contact id (from get_contact or a message's contact_id).
